findings.summary: False overflow in mixed-direction text: parley hangs white space only at the paragraph level. 'a ابج دهو' at width 32 fits and flags overflow
Hand mutant survived: overflow taken from the last line only
Hand mutant survived: .notdef read from the first glyph only; q + U+0301 is the uncovered case
Hand mutants survived: ranges before non-finite checks, numbers after fonts. No test has two bad inputs
InvalidFont puts a number in Text; ADR 0012 item 3 requires a numeric argument. tests/message.rs pins the wrong form
Entry says the C2PA original is kept outside the repository; pending item 6 (b) of 00 keeps that as VERIFICAR
White-space-only text in a box of 0 gives no overflow; the row says overflow if the text is not empty
Line count of a final newline and of an empty text is stated nowhere; tests pin it
An empty font stack gives Ok with no clusters, no flag: the text is lost. No row, test or note covers it
05 asks hash, authorship, attribution and modified per entry; P7 sets other fields
Copyright year differs from the font name table: Inter 2020 vs 2016, Manrope 2018 vs 2019. Record both
Zero-metrics font gives Ok, not Err; row belongs with TX2 but the notes omit it. Carry it to TX2
Splash modificado=false not derivable: D-09 is silent and the repository copy lacks the C2PA of the original download. Owner to state it
No test recomputes BLAKE3: a changed hash digit passes. Needs a new dev-dependency; no stated rule forbids the absence
Row says Err of invalid font; the code gives a separate NoFont variant and key, not recorded as a deviation
Amended acceptance texts partly untested (white space in a box of 0, abc CRLF); white-space mutant survived; all pass by probe
Zero-advance clusters outside White_Space (U+200B and others) give no overflow in a box of 0; the row and ARQ-116 disagree
Quadratic in trailing white space: 100 000 spaces 27 s in debug, 0.19 s with a set. No spec budget; release not measured
Line breaking counts one spacing the output drops: Hello t=500 splits in a box it fits; t=-100 stays whole with overflow true
Alignment counts the same spacing: justified line ends at 88.4 of 90 at t=100; right ends at 192 of 200 at t=500, 201.6 at t=-100
Ok with infinity in the output: height (box), indent, x and top (list). Huge dpi. Output check skips them
Font with no post table gives thickness 1/18 em from parley, not 0.05 em
Hand mutant M3 survived: last cluster in visual order. Per-cluster test is LTR only
Hand mutant M2 survived: forced break as last cluster. Tests read line totals only
Hand mutant M6 survived: no NoFont check; layout_list with no items and no fonts is untested
Fonts whose metrics do not nest: lh 1 gives 121.289, formula 120.996; (f) off by 0.59 px. Formula contradicts the CSS reference and (c)
TDD breach for lists: code and tests written together, RED shown afterwards on a stub, which the owner forbids
Doc and test name say fonts before levels; code checks levels first. Mutant M4 survived
Mutant M5 survived: height doubled. top == height is a tautology; TX3 builds on it
Note says zero-metrics font with empty text is Ok; measured Err(InvalidFont). No test
Zero-metrics font nothing uses gives Ok, pinned by a test; the row has no such limit
Ranges index the converted text; ARQ-116 says input text. No map to the source
Indent step stated, origin not: (level-1) and level both meet (j)
Space after a marker and wrapped lines under the marker are stated nowhere; designers expect hanging text
A bullet resetting the count of its level is not stated
Trailing spaces move right-aligned text 12 px off the edge; wrapped lines hang theirs. FD-41 silent; recommended: hang
Last cluster of a line ending in a hanging space is undefined; ink stops one spacing short
Formula cannot hold where a ligature forms at 0: Manrope fifl 0.344 px off; needs an exception
FD-41 cites ARQ-42, whose row is about preview and export; no test names it. Behaviour holds
